message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts: Defendant Li drove a crane, helped Liu cut tree, swung tree, tree root broke, hit Liu, Liu died. So Li's behavior caused death. Likely crime: negligence homicide (过失致人死亡) under Criminal Law article 233 (过失致人死亡). Also possibly dangerous driving? But he was operating crane, not vehicle. Could be "以危险方法危害公共安全罪"? But the act was using crane to swing tree causing death. The appropriate charge is "过失致人死亡罪". Also maybe "非法经营危险物品"? No. So only one crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡<eoa>
